sources.title: Supabase guides
sources.note: Every guide page of supabase.com/docs: Auth, Database and RLS, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, local development, self-hosting, platform, troubleshooting. The full list exists only in sitemap.xml (llms.txt names just the 20 section roots); each page is fetched as its markdown twin.

sources.title: Supabase features catalog
sources.note: One document per feature of supabase.com/features: what it does, its product, its stage (General Availability, Beta...), whether it exists on self-hosted, and the guide it is documented in. The pages have no markdown twins; the text comes from their __NEXT_DATA__.
